name: Sempra

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Sempra h tm rgb c.jpg), JPG 1551 px wide because no SVG of the current mark was found

description: Sempra is a utility holding company whose principal businesses are regulated utilities in California (San Diego Gas & Electric and Southern California Gas) and Texas (an 80.25% stake in Oncor, the largest transmission and distribution system in Texas by customers, which is not consolidated but counted by the equity method). A third segment, Sempra Infrastructure, holds LNG, pipelines and Mexican energy assets; Sempra has agreed to sell 45% of it to KKR for $9.99 billion and its Mexican gas utility Ecogas, which will leave it with a 25% interest. Utilities earn regulated returns on rate base (CPUC allows 9.93% and 9.78% ROE for SDG&E and SoCalGas from 2026; the PUCT allows Oncor 9.70% now, 9.75% under the 2026 settlement), so earnings follow capital invested. In 2025 gas utility revenue ($7.3B) was larger than electric ($4.6B) in the consolidated income statement.

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Utilities', Sub-Industry 'Multi-Utilities' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30); that list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4932 (Gas & Other Services Combined) per EDGAR.

hq.note: EDGAR business address San Diego, CA

employees.note: Sempra consolidated, 6,131 under collective bargaining; excludes equity-method investees (Oncor has about 5,600 employees); includes 3,048 employees in the disposal group held for sale (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Sempra California
businessLines.how: Customers pay CPUC- and FERC-approved rates monthly for electricity and gas delivery; the utilities earn an authorised return (9.78% to 9.93% ROE on 52% equity) on rate base, while the commodity cost of gas for core customers is passed through. Wildfire liability exposure sits against this regulated return.
businessLines.description: SDG&E (electric to about 3.6 million people and gas to about 3.3 million in San Diego County and part of Orange County) and SoCalGas (natural gas distribution, transmission and four storage fields with 137 Bcf of working gas capacity).

revenue.note: Segment total revenues incl. $364M utilities regulatory revenues (FY2025 10-K Note 3); SDG&E $5,697M and SoCalGas $6,291M stand-alone (FY2025 10-K statements of operations); gas $7,263M, electric $4,555M within the segment

businessLines.revenueNote: Segment total revenues incl. $364M utilities regulatory revenues (FY2025 10-K Note 3); SDG&E $5,697M and SoCalGas $6,291M stand-alone (FY2025 10-K statements of operations); gas $7,263M, electric $4,555M within the segment

operatingProfit.note: Segment earnings attributable to common shares (FY2024 $1,846M)

businessLines.name: Sempra Texas Utilities
businessLines.how: Oncor charges Texas retail electricity providers regulated delivery rates set by the PUCT, earning a set ROE on a fast-growing rate base; Sempra books 80.25% of Oncor's profit through the equity method.
businessLines.description: Equity-method investments: Oncor Holdings (80.25% of Oncor, the Texas electric transmission and distribution utility serving more than 4.1 million homes and businesses over 145,000 circuit miles) and a 50% interest in Sharyland Holdings. Not consolidated, so no revenue appears in Sempra's income statement.

operatingProfit.note: Segment earnings attributable to common shares (FY2024 $781M)

businessLines.name: Sempra Infrastructure
businessLines.how: Long-term contracted capacity and tolling fees from LNG terminals and pipelines plus regulated tariffs in Mexico; customers (utilities, LNG buyers, industrials) pay fixed fees under multi-year contracts.
businessLines.description: Develops, builds, operates and invests in LNG (liquefaction and regasification), natural gas and power networks and low-carbon projects in the U.S. and Mexico; includes Mexican gas utility Ecogas. Sempra owns 70% of SI Partners (KKR Pinnacle 20%, ADIA 10%); classified as held for sale.
